title: Enable chatbot interactions on a display or mobile site
summary: Let a Dialogflow chatbot trigger campaign playback on a display, started either on the display itself or on the visitor's phone.
bodyMd:
When the platform is connected to Dialogflow, a visitor's conversation can drive what plays on a display. Triggered campaigns are mapped to intents (the synonyms and utterances the chatbot recognises); when a visitor's words match one, the campaign plays on the connected display. You enable this per display, and choose whether the chatbot starts on the display or on the visitor's phone. Allow about 2 minutes.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with permission to manage displays and devices.
  • The platform is integrated with Dialogflow, and triggered campaigns are set up and mapped to intents. See Connect a triggered campaign to an AI agent interaction.
  • If the chatbot will run on the display itself, a microphone or webcam is connected to the display and its volume is audible.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Select the display's Name, for example Branch Entrance.
  3. Select the Enabled Features tab.
  4. Tick Enable Chatbot / Voice Recognition.
  5. Choose the Dialogflow intent to trigger, for example Trigger_QR_Control_Intent.
  6. Choose the token to send to the chatbot. Tokens personalise the conversation, for example Hi ${FirstName}, welcome to ${BrandName} ${StoreName}.
  7. Choose where the chatbot starts: on the display, or on the visitor's mobile device.
  8. Select Save Changes.
If you choose to start the chatbot on the display, the display must have a microphone or webcam connected and its volume turned up. Without them the chatbot cannot hear or answer the visitor.

Verify it worked

Speak (on the display) or type (on the mobile site) a phrase mapped to the intent. The matching triggered campaign starts playing on the display, and the interaction appears on the display's Campaign Playback tab.
